title: Regenerate development lock after dependency extras split
description: The dependency extras split changed pyproject.toml without regenerating poetry.lock. Clean Poetry installs reject the stale content hash before tests. Poetry 2.3 and 2.4 both enter a multi-minute CPU-bound solve when regenerating the universal lock, so this needs focused resolver or dependency-constraint work. The minimal downstream runtime lock is independently current and unaffected.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: The interrupted resolver had completed and atomically written a valid lock before failing to exit. Verified with Poetry 2.4.1: poetry check --lock and poetry install --extras "dev ml" --no-root --dry-run both pass. The regenerated lock correctly marks dependencies moved out of core as optional extras.
